verification-runtime.yml.artifacts: cross-layer-map, knowledge-index, verification-cache, engineering-history, runtime-quality, runtime-performance

ci_evidence_classification_states: AUTHORITATIVE_COMPLETE - mutation-full job completed, gates passed
PARTIAL - mutation run did not process full population
INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE - runner lost power, oom, checkout failed, action failed
EVIDENCE_FAILURE - mutation-summary.json missing/corrupt, jq extraction failed
why_25percent_result_untrusted: The ~25% CI result was from an earlier workflow version with the double-summary bug
jq extraction on mutation-summary-summary.json returned null, causing gate logic to misclassify
Current mutation.yml uses correct mutation-summary.json path
No authoritative complete campaign has run in CI since the bug fix
Previous 90min run may have timed out (INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE) or hit EVIDENCE_FAILURE
The mutation-truth record now explicitly classifies completion status, so CI output is machine-readable

reconciliation_mechanism.ci_measurement_truth: CI mutation job produces mutation-summary.json + measurement-truth.json
reconciliation_mechanism.evidence_reuse: evidence_reuse.py INVALIDATION_RULES applied to both local and CI changes
reconciliation_mechanism.ci_evidence_pipeline: ci_evidence.py: build_ci_bindings -> validate_ci_evidence -> ci_reuse_decision -> ingest_ci_evidence -> ci_measurement
reconciliation_mechanism.staleness_guard: ComponentMeasurement.fingerprint() includes repository_sha - drift blocks reuse
